_comment: Model ids for the Software Council (PRD change 5: ids in config, not code). Lenses get lens_models round-robin, so put the small fast models first; the chairman gets the strongest. Prefix an id with ollama:, openrouter:, gemini: or fake: to pin its provider and send the id unchanged; a bare id keeps the automatic routing. Override with --config, SW_COUNCIL_CONFIG, --lens-model, --chairman-model or SW_COUNCIL_MODELS.
